entries.semantics: A visible grapheme tile contributes its explicitly declared French letter-name reading; it is never strict whole-word evidence.
entries.nextGate: keep explicit in UI and preserve phonetic tests
entries.authorizationEvidence: Existing general-mode grapheme constructions are already part of the product runtime and coverage tests.

entries.semantics: Visible D contributes only /d/ when the IPA cue is shown; this is distinct from the French letter name /de/.
entries.nextGate: human comprehension test of grapheme plus IPA cue

entries.semantics: Visible GN contributes /ɲ/ only with an explicit sound cue; no contextual spelling rule is inferred.

entries.semantics: TR is only a documented research lead; no standalone context-free sound value is authorized.
entries.nextGate: define context-sensitive semantics or reject standalone tile

entries.semantics: MENT may contribute /mɑ̃/ only for a declared source word whose orthography ends in MENT and whose declared whole-word IPA ends exactly in /mɑ̃/. Orthography alone never licenses the operation.
entries.nextGate: define a visible source-evidence cue and test comprehension before authorization

entries.semantics: TION may contribute /sjɔ̃/ only for a declared source word ending in TION whose declared whole-word IPA ends exactly in /sjɔ̃/. Words such as question with /tjɔ̃/ do not qualify.
entries.nextGate: define a visible source-evidence cue and test comprehension before authorization

entries.semantics: SION may contribute /sjɔ̃/ only for a declared source word ending in SION whose declared whole-word IPA ends exactly in /sjɔ̃/. Words such as vision with /zjɔ̃/ do not qualify.
entries.nextGate: define a visible source-evidence cue and test comprehension before authorization

entries.semantics: IN remains blocked: a substring match is insufficient to prove which phoneme span the grapheme realizes, and nasal versus oral readings are context-dependent.
entries.nextGate: add reliable grapheme-to-phoneme alignment evidence before defining any operation
